description: osirAppSetSecret: Set an environment secret for an Osir app (e.g. DATABASE_URL, API_KEY). The value is stored encrypted and injected as an env var on the next osirAppDeploy of the app; it is NEVER returned or logged. Requires authentication.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

value.description: The secret value; never returned or logged.

name: osirAppSetSecret
